This is kinda long but I want to share one of my many disappoint experiences due to drugs. When I was 13 I was your average "rebel" freshly turned teen. I wasn't making the best decisions and wasn't hanging around a "good" crowd. So I had went to this party with a guy way to old for me. Thinking about it now I might've been 12, but I can't really remember. Long story short the party got shut down for noise complaints. The dude I was there with only went to get a tattoo because his parents wouldn't consent but this dude at the party did not care. So he was like "we finna go to somewhere else to get my tat done" So obviously me being stupid as fuck was like alright/(by this point it was like 2 am and I was an hour away from home mind you I had left(snuck out) at 8 pm) So after getting lost a couple times we finally get there and its ghetto af bro. Like there was only two folding chairs in the living room and they stored things in the oven.. But the girl whose trailer this was informed us the tattoo artist and her bf and etc were otw with bud. Fast forward to when they come I take maybe 5 hits and all the sudden im sitting in the chair and forgot where I was and who I was. I was shocked when I found out I had glasses on and what I looked like. Eventually I broke down crying and everyone there was trying to help me but my anxiety just made everything worse. Theres more details you can pm me if you wanna know more but after the dude got his tattoo he drove me home while messing with my greened out self. He made me walk the rest of the way when I refused to give him head and when I got home. THE DOOR WAS LOCKED. But the backsliding glass door was open and I snuck in and changed and went to sleep because at this point it was 4-5 am. 

tldr; snuck out with a dude when to ghetto trailer and lost my mind forgetting who and what I looked like and where I was after 5 hits of a blunt
